raw: {"analysis":"NRZ provides a more operationally sound plan by correctly sequencing the HSM update before software deployment, and its rollback strategy acknowledges the critical asymmetry: software rollback is reversible but HSM updates are not. PZM makes a dangerous error in its rollback plan by suggesting 'revert HSM config to legacy-only' when the repository facts explicitly state HSM pushes are irreversible and will brick remote update capabilities. NRZ also handles the staging latency issue more pragmatically by provisioning production-equivalent resources rather than dismissing staging metrics entirely, and correctly identifies that full crypto simulation should run on release candidates to manage CI costs.","verdict":"NRZ"}
